outcome: placental histological features (infectious inflammatory lesions, maternal vascular malperfusion lesions)
cohort: Women who delivered spontaneously or with indicated preterm birth between 17 and 37 weeks of gestation in 2009 were included.
finding: Maternal vascular malperfusion lesions are most frequent in both spontaneous and indicated very and moderate/late preterm birth, while chorioamnionitis is the main finding in spontaneous extreme preterm birth.
